import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorModulesMultiplication
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorModulesInclusion

/-!
# Multiplication and divisor-module inclusions

For a nonpositive divisor `E`, multiplication into `O(D + E)` followed by its
inclusion in `O(D)` is the tensor action induced by `O(E) -> O_X`.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite TopologicalSpace
open scoped TensorProduct

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme

attribute [local instance] functionFieldOverModule overModule

variable (K : Type u) [Field K] {X : Scheme.{u}}
  [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))] [IsIntegral X]
  [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
  [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]

/-- For a nonpositive divisor factor, multiplication followed by inclusion agrees
with its action through the structure sheaf. -/
theorem divisorModulesMul_comp_LE_of_nonpos
    (D : X.CurveDivisor) {E : X.CurveDivisor} (hE : E ≤ 0) :
    divisorModulesMul K D E ≫
        divisorModulesLE K (show D + E ≤ D from fun z => by
          have h := hE z
          change D.toFun z + E.toFun z ≤ D.toFun z
          change E.toFun z ≤ 0 at h
          omega) =
      Modules.tensorObj_functoriality (𝟙 (divisorModules K D))
          (divisorModulesLE K hE ≫ (divisorModulesZeroIso K).hom) ≫
        (Modules.tensorObj_right_unitor (divisorModules K D)).hom := by
  let adj := PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction (𝟙 X.ringCatSheaf.obj)
  let F := PresheafOfModules.sheafification (R := X.ringCatSheaf) (𝟙 X.ringCatSheaf.obj)
  let hDE : D + E ≤ D := fun z => by
    have h := hE z
    change D.toFun z + E.toFun z ≤ D.toFun z
    change E.toFun z ≤ 0 at h
    omega
  apply (adj.homEquiv
    (Modules.tensorPresheaf (divisorModules K D) (divisorModules K E))
    (divisorModules K D)).injective
  change adj.homEquiv _ _
      ((adj.homEquiv _ _).symm (divisorModulesMulPresheaf K D E) ≫
        divisorModulesLE K hDE) =
    adj.homEquiv _ _
      (F.map (MonoidalCategory.tensorHom
        (C := _root_.PresheafOfModules (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat))
        (𝟙 (divisorModules K D).val)
        ((divisorModulesLE K hE).val ≫ (divisorModulesZeroIso K).hom.val)) ≫
      (F.map
        ((PresheafOfModules.monoidalCategoryStruct (R := X.presheaf)).rightUnitor
          (divisorModules K D).val).hom ≫ adj.counit.app (divisorModules K D)))
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right, Equiv.apply_symm_apply,
    Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_left, Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_left,
    ← Adjunction.homEquiv_symm_id]
  erw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply, Category.comp_id]
  ext U : 1
  apply ModuleCat.MonoidalCategory.tensor_ext
  intro s t
  change (divisorModulesLE K hDE).app U.unop (divisorSectionsProduct K s t) =
    ((divisorModulesZeroIso K).hom.app U.unop
      ((divisorModulesLE K hE).app U.unop t)) • s
  by_cases hU : (U.unop : Set X).Nonempty
  · apply divisorSection_ext K
    change divisorVal K ((divisorModulesLE K hDE).app U.unop
        (divisorSectionsProduct K s t)) =
      divisorVal K (QcohOn.qsmul (F := X.divisorSheaf K D) le_rfl
        ((divisorModulesZeroIso K).hom.app U.unop
          ((divisorModulesLE K hE).app U.unop t)) s)
    rw [divisorVal_divisorModulesLE, divisorVal_divisorSectionsProduct,
      divisorVal_qsmul K (genericPoint_mem_of_nonempty hU),
      germ_divisorModulesZeroIso_hom K hU, divisorVal_divisorModulesLE, mul_comm]
  · exact @Subsingleton.elim (divisorSections K D U.unop)
      (divisorSections_subsingleton_of_empty K hU) _ _

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme
